questions.q: I read the manual twice, but I'm still none the ___.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *none the wiser*. *wise*, *wisest*, *more wise* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: I can't afford a holiday, ___ a new car.
questions.why: Після заперечення «не кажучи вже про» — *let alone*. *not to mention of* — зайве *of*; *let only* і *leave alone to* — неправильні вирази.

questions.q: He can't even make toast, let alone ___ a proper meal.
questions.why: Після *let alone* — та сама форма, що в першій частині (*make*): *cook*. *to cook*, *cooking*, *cooked* — інша форма.

questions.q: If the hotel has a pool, all the ___.
questions.why: *all the better* — тим краще. *all the best* — побажання; *more better* — подвоєння; *all the good* — неграматично.

questions.q: The repair cost ___ less than £2,000 — we were shocked.
questions.why: «Аж, цілих» — *no less than*. *nothing less than* — «не що інше, як», з сумою не вживають; *none* і *any less than* — неграматично тут.

questions.q: The journey took no ___ than twenty minutes — much quicker than we expected.
questions.why: «Лише, усього» — *no more than*. *no less than* — наголос на великій кількості, суперечить «швидше»; *no longer than than* — подвоєння; *no most* — неграматично.

questions.q: After cleaning, the old sofa looked as good as ___.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *as good as new*. *a new* і *the new* — з артиклем неправильно; *newly* — прислівник.

questions.q: Many people helped us, not ___ our neighbours.
questions.why: «Особливо, не в останню чергу» — *not least*. *not less*, *not the least*, *not lesser* — неправильні або інший зміст.

questions.q: ___ often than not, the train is late.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *More often than not* (найчастіше). *Most*, *Much*, *Many* у ньому не вживають.

questions.q: I'd sooner walk ___ wait an hour for the bus.
questions.why: *would sooner … than*. *as*, *then*, *to* у цій конструкції не вживають.

questions.q: Her success makes his failure all the ___ painful.
questions.why: *all the more* + прикметник — тим більше. *most*, *much*, *many* — неправильні в цьому звороті.

questions.q: He fell off his horse but was none the ___ for it.
questions.why: *none the worse for* — анітрохи не постраждав. *worst*, *bad*, *more bad* — неправильні форми.

questions.q: Tickets for the final cost as ___ as £500.
questions.why: *as much as* + сума — наголос на кількості.

questions.q: Choosing between the two plans was a case of the ___ of two evils.
questions.why: *the lesser of two evils* — менше з двох лих.

questions.q: That's all the ___ reason to start right now.
questions.why: *all the more reason* — тим більше причин.

questions.q: The project is as good ___ finished.

answer: She can't swim let alone dive
She can't swim, let alone dive
questions.why: *let alone* + та сама форма, що й у першій частині.

answer: I read it twice but I am none the wiser
I read it twice, but I am none the wiser
questions.why: *none the wiser* — так і не зрозумів.
